title: AC Milan Football Legend Franco Baresi Dies at 66
summary: Former AC Milan defender and Italian football icon Franco Baresi has died at the age of 66. His last public appearance was at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics opening ceremony in February, where he carried the Olympic torch into the San Siro stadium. AC Milan announced his death, describing the club as being 'in tears'.
summary_points: Franco Baresi, a former AC Milan defender, has died at age 66.
He was an Italian football icon.
Baresi's last public appearance was at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics opening ceremony in February.
He carried the Olympic torch into the San Siro stadium during the ceremony.
AC Milan expressed grief over his passing.

summary_hi: एसी मिलान के पूर्व डिफेंडर और इतालवी फुटबॉल आइकन फ्रांको बारेसी का 66 वर्ष की आयु में निधन हो गया है। उनकी अंतिम सार्वजनिक उपस्थिति फरवरी में मिलान कोर्टिना शीतकालीन ओलंपिक के उद्घाटन समारोह में हुई थी, जहाँ उन्होंने सैन सिरो स्टेडियम में ओलंपिक मशाल ले जाई थी। एसी मिलान ने उनके निधन की घोषणा करते हुए कहा कि क्लब 'शोक में है'।
